title: 第六章 林泞姗
content_zh:
张若尘、林妃、侍女云儿坐着一辆羚马古车，徐徐的行出云武王宫。..
羚马，并不是真正的马，而是一种头上长着独角的蛮兽，身躯高达三米多，就像是一头小象，奔跑的速度是普通战马以上。其中一些健壮的羚马，甚至能够做到日行三千里。
羚马古车也不知行了多远，逐渐停了下来。
张若尘从车中走下来，看着不远处的金碧辉煌的两扇大门，又看了看挂在大门顶部的金边匾额，上面书写着两个苍劲有力的大字： “林府！”
他的心头一动，娘亲不就姓 “林”？
看这一座府邸的气派样子，林家并不是什么小家小户，而是一派大家族的风范。
若是娘亲的娘家真的是大家族，又为何得不到娘家的支持，反而在郡王府中处处受到别的王妃的欺凌？
肯定有隐情。
林妃也从马车中走下来，抬头看了一眼那一扇即是熟悉而又陌生的大门，道： “尘儿，你肯定早就想要见泞姗了吧！现在你也开辟出神武印记，相信你和泞姗有很多话题可以谈，你可一定要加油啊！”
到现在为止，张若尘都不知道泞姗到底是什么人，听到云儿和林妃的话，总有一种怪怪的感觉。
在林妃的带领下，张若尘和云儿一起走进林府。
王妃回到家族，理论上是应该受到隆重的接迎，但是将林妃和张若尘接迎进大门的仅仅只是一个年长的管家。
林妃被那一位老管家带去内府，张若尘和云儿则留在外府，只有两位侍女留下来接待他们。
张若尘总感觉气氛很不对劲，却又不知道该如何询问，只能继续保持沉默。
“九王子，你不去见泞姗吗？她现在应该就在演武场，林家的那些年轻子弟，应该都在那里修炼。”云儿问道。
被云儿和林妃提了几次，张若尘的心头便更加好奇，那一个叫做 “泞姗”的女子到底是谁？去见一见，应该也无妨。
“嗯！走吧，去林家的演武场。”张若尘点了点头道。
林家的内府。
一座古色古香的厅堂中，林家的家主林奉先四平八稳的坐在太师椅上。
他看上去三十来岁的样子，嘴唇上方留着两撇整齐的胡须，向着坐在对面的林妃看了一眼，道： “九王子乃是郡王府的后代子孙，就算开启了神武印记，也该去郡王府的藏书阁挑选修炼功法，林妃娘娘为何要来林家索要修炼功法？”

林妃轻轻的咬了咬嘴唇，道： “不是索要，是我请求大兄看在尘儿是你的亲外甥的情分上，能够给他一卷修炼的功法。”
“嘭！”
林奉先冷哼一声，一掌拍在桌面上，道： “现在知道来求我这个兄长了？现在来跟我讲情分？三年前，我去郡王府求你的时候，你怎么没有看在辰裕是你的亲外甥的情分上救他？你明知道，辰裕是我的嫡子，更是林家百年难出的一位绝世天才，只要你去求郡王，总能将他保住，但是，你却没有……”
“三年前……”林妃十分的委屈，忍不住流泪，想要说出三年前的真相。
但是，林奉先却打断了她的话，道： “你走吧！林家和你早就已经恩断义绝，今后也不要再回来了。林妃娘娘。”
“咚！”
林妃直接跪在地上，不停流泪，声音呜咽的道： “大哥，你就如此绝情吗？我要见爹。”
“爹去了天魔岭，三个月之后才会回来，你现在见不到他的。”林奉先淡漠的道： “还有一件事，泞姗和七王子殿下就要订婚了，叫九王子殿下今后离泞姗远一点。”
林妃的心中更加绝望，道： “你明知道尘儿一直喜欢泞姗，他若是知道
泞姗和七王子订婚，会何等的伤心？再说，怎么会是七王子？”
林奉先道： “七王子殿下在三岁的时候，便开启七品神武印记，天资何等惊艳？以他如今的武道修为，整个云武郡国的年轻一代，根本没有人可以望其项背。泞姗能够和七王子殿下结成连理，对我们林家的将来有巨大的好处。”
“九王子虽然和泞姗是表兄妹，小时候也是很好的玩伴，算得上青梅竹马。但是，九王子毕竟资质平庸，十六岁才开启神武印记，今生也不会有多大的成就，能够修炼到黄极境后期应该就是极限了，与七王子根本没法比。”
林妃道： “泞姗也愿意与七王子订婚？为了家族利益的结合，真的会幸福吗？”
林奉先盯着林妃，淡漠的道： “你错了，这本就是泞姗自己的决定！”
林家的演武场，十分开阔，足有半个足球场那么大。
一个个穿着青色武衣的林家年轻子弟，正在演武场上修炼武技，有的在修炼拳法，有的在修炼剑法，有的在修炼刀法。
他们属于林家的精英，每一个都开启了神武印记，专心致志的修炼。同时也有林家的长辈在演武场中对他们进行指点，一派欣欣向荣的气象。
张若尘点了点头，心头暗道， “林家在云武郡国也算得上是大族了。”
忽然，张若尘的目光盯在一个身材纤细的少女的身上，不禁有些惊艳。
只见那少女看上去也就只有十四，身材娇小玲珑，黛眉如柳叶，眼眸明亮似星辰，肌肤雪白似灵玉，好一个美人胚子。

她手持一柄散发着淡淡星光的宝剑，散发出淡青色的剑芒，无数剑气环绕在她的身体周围，跟随着她的步伐游走，翩若惊鸿，婉若游龙，剑法简直精妙到了极点。
“真气外放，剑随心走。她的武道修为至少也达到了黄极境中极位，比八王子强大太多了。”张若尘心头暗道。
“咦！那不是九王子吗？他居然还来林府？”一个林家的年轻子弟看到站在演武场外的张若尘，露出几分冷冽的笑意。
“肯定又是来找泞姗妹妹，可惜啊，泞姗妹妹现在根本都懒得见他。”
“听说他也开启了神武印记。”
“嘻！十六岁才开启神武印记，能有什么做为？若他不是泞姗妹妹的表哥，说不定连林家的大门都进不了。”
“听说泞姗妹妹就要和七王子订婚了，真是郎才女貌啊！”
“嘿嘿！据说那一位九王子一直都暗恋泞姗妹妹，你们猜，若是他听说泞姗和七王子殿下就要订婚，会是什么表情？”
林家的那些年轻武者全部都停下修炼，盯着站在演武场外的张若尘，指指点点，议论纷纷，时而发出戏谑的笑声。
林泞姗也停止练剑，向着站在演武场外的张若尘看了一眼，纤细的玉臂轻轻一挥，手中的星辉宝剑便精准的插外的剑鞘。
林泞姗走到张若尘的面前，看了看张若尘单薄的身体，道： “表哥，好久不见，听说你也开启了神武印记？”
在很小的时候，林泞姗和张若尘还是很好的玩伴，算得上是青梅竹马，但是后来林泞姗开启了神武印记，大多数的时间便花费在修炼上面，与张若尘越来越疏远。
三年前的事情发生之后，她便再也没有去过云武王宫。张若尘虽然常年多病，却依旧时常去林家找她，哪怕是能够见她一面，也会觉得相当开心。
但是，能够见到她的次数却越来越少，最近半年更是从未见到过她。她都是派遣一位侍女出来，将张若尘打发离开。
“原来她是我的表妹。”
现在的张若尘可以说是第一次见到林泞姗，对她并没有什么感觉，所以显
得很平静，谦虚了一句： “的确是开启了神武印记，不过王后娘娘说只是没有品级的神武印记，自然是不能和表妹的神武印记相提并论。”
林泞姗点了点头，仰着雪白的下巴，高傲得就像一只白天鹅，道： “你毕竟已经十六岁了，能够开启神武印记，也算是上天对你的恩赐。今后一定要努力修炼，虽然不能成为武道强者，但是至少可以强身健体，不用常年卧在病床上，对你来说……至少可以做一个正常人了。”
张若尘微微的皱了皱眉，点了点头，道： “我今后一定会努力修炼，争取追上表妹你的修为。”
林泞姗自然知道张若尘喜欢她，听到张若尘的话，就以为张若尘依旧不死心，还想继续追求她。

“诶！表哥，我的修为已经达到黄极境中极境，离大极境也只有一步之遥。以你的资质，估计一生也修炼不到中极境，对你现在来说最应该做的就是脚踏实地的修炼，不要盲目的追求一些不该追求的东西，做人不能好高骛远，不然会反受其害。”林泞姗一语双关的说道。
张若尘的眉头皱得更深。
林泞姗有些同情的看了张若尘一眼，道： “表哥，还有一件事情我要告诉你，希望你不要太伤心。三个月之后，等到郡王出关，我和七王子殿下应该就要订婚了。”
“有好戏看了！嘿嘿！”
林家的那些年轻武者，全部都心头大乐，纷纷将目光盯向张若尘，想要看张若尘会是什么样的反应？
content_en:
Zhang Ruochen, Concubine Lin, and maid Yun'er sat in an ancient antelope-horse chariot and slowly walked out of the Yunwu Palace. ..
The antelope horse is not a real horse, but a savage beast with a single horn on its head. Its body is more than three meters tall, like a small elephant, and its running speed is faster than that of an ordinary war horse. Some of these strong antelope horses can even travel three thousand miles a day.
The ancient Lingma chariot did not know how far it traveled and gradually stopped.
Zhang Ruochen walked out of the car and looked at the two splendid gates not far away, and then at the gold-rimmed plaque hanging on the top of the gate, which had two powerful characters written on it: "Lin Mansion!"
A thought occurred to him, isn't his mother's surname "Lin"?
Judging from the grand appearance of this mansion, the Lin family is not a small family, but a large family.
If my mother's family is really a big family, why can't I get the support from my mother's family and be bullied by other princesses in the prince's palace?
There must be something hidden.
Concubine Lin also walked out of the carriage, looked up at the familiar yet unfamiliar door, and said, "Chen'er, you must have wanted to see Ningshan for a long time! Now that you have also opened up the mark of Shenwu, I believe you and Ningshan have many topics to talk about, so you must work hard!"
Until now, Zhang Ruochen didn't know who Ningshan was. He always had a strange feeling when he heard Yun'er and Concubine Lin's words.
Under the leadership of Concubine Lin, Zhang Ruochen and Yun'er walked into the Lin Mansion together.
In theory, when the princess returned to the family, she should be given a grand welcome, but it was only an older housekeeper who welcomed Concubine Lin and Zhang Ruochen into the door.
Concubine Lin was taken to the inner palace by the old housekeeper, while Zhang Ruochen and Yun'er stayed in the outer palace. Only two maids stayed to receive them.
Zhang Ruochen always felt that something was wrong with the atmosphere, but he didn't know how to ask, so he could only remain silent.
"Ninth Prince, aren't you going to see Ningshan? She should be at the martial arts field now, and the young disciples of the Lin family should be practicing there." Yun'er asked.
After being mentioned several times by Yun'er and Concubine Lin, Zhang Ruochen became even more curious. Who is that woman named "Ningshan"? It shouldn't hurt to go and meet him.
"Yeah! Let's go to the Lin family's martial arts arena." Zhang Ruochen nodded.
The inner palace of the Lin family.
In an antique hall, Lin Fengxian, the head of the Lin family, sat steadily on the Taishi chair.
He looked to be in his thirties, with two neat beards above his lips. He glanced at Concubine Lin, who was sitting across from him, and said, "The ninth prince is a descendant of the prince's palace. Even if the mark of divine martial arts is activated, he should go to the library of the prince's palace to select the cultivation techniques. Why does Concubine Lin come to the Lin family to ask for the cultivation techniques?"
Concubine Lin bit her lip gently and said, "It's not a request, I'm asking my eldest brother to give Chen'er a volume of practice skills because he is your nephew."
"Bang!"
Lin Fengxian snorted coldly, slapped his palm on the table and said: "Now you know how to beg my brother? Now you want to talk to me about your love? Three years ago, when I went to the county prince's palace to beg you, why didn't you save Chenyu because he was your nephew? You clearly know that Chenyu is my legitimate son, and he is a peerless genius that is rare in the Lin family for a century. As long as you go to the county prince, you can always save him, but you didn't..."
"Three years ago..." Concubine Lin felt very wronged and couldn't help crying, wanting to tell the truth about three years ago.
However, Lin Fengxian interrupted her and said, "Go away! The Lin family has severed all ties with you long ago, and you will never come back again. Concubine Lin."
"Boom!"
Concubine Lin knelt on the ground, crying non-stop, and said in a whimpering voice: "Brother, are you so heartless? I want to see dad."
"Dad went to Tianmo Ridge and won't come back until three months later. You can't see him now.his. Lin Fengxian said indifferently: "One more thing. Ningshan and His Highness the Seventh Prince are about to get engaged. Please tell His Highness the Ninth Prince to stay away from Ningshan from now on." "
Concubine Lin became even more desperate and said, "You know that Chen'er has always liked Ningshan. If he knew
How sad will Ningshan be when she is engaged to the Seventh Prince? Besides, how could he be the seventh prince? "
Lin Fengxian said: "His Royal Highness the Seventh Prince opened the Mark of the Seventh Grade Divine Martial Arts when he was three years old. How amazing is his talent? With his current level of martial arts cultivation, no one in the younger generation in the entire Yunwu County can come close to him. Ningshan's ability to marry His Highness the Seventh Prince will be of great benefit to the future of our Lin family. "
"Although Ninth Prince and Ningshan are cousins, they were also very good playmates when they were young, and they can be considered childhood sweethearts. However, the Ninth Prince has mediocre qualifications after all. He only opened the Divine Martial Mark at the age of sixteen, and he will not achieve much in this life. Being able to practice to the late Huangji Realm is probably the limit, and he is incomparable with the Seventh Prince. "
Concubine Lin said: "Ningshan is also willing to be engaged to the seventh prince? Will you really be happy if you combine family interests? "
Lin Fengxian stared at Concubine Lin and said indifferently: "You are wrong, this is Ningshan's own decision! "
The Lin family's martial arts performance field is very open, as big as half a football field.
Young disciples of the Lin family wearing cyan martial arts uniforms are practicing martial arts on the martial arts field. Some are practicing boxing, some are practicing swordsmanship, and some are practicing swordsmanship.
They belong to the elite of the Lin family. Each of them has activated the mark of divine martial arts and is dedicated to practicing. At the same time, there were also elders of the Lin family giving them guidance in the martial arts arena, creating a prosperous atmosphere.
Zhang Ruochen nodded and thought to himself, "The Lin family can be considered a wealthy family in Yunwu County. "
Suddenly, Zhang Ruochen's eyes were fixed on a slender girl, and he couldn't help but be a little surprised.
The girl looked only fourteen years old. She was petite and exquisite, with dark eyebrows like willow leaves, eyes as bright as stars, and skin as white as jade. She was such a beauty.
She held a sword that exuded a faint starlight, emitting a light cyan sword light. Countless sword energy surrounded her body, following her steps, as graceful as a startling giant, as graceful as a swimming dragon. Her sword skills were simply exquisite to the extreme.
“Let your true energy flow outward and move your sword as you please. Her martial arts cultivation level has at least reached the extreme level of Huang Ji Realm, which is much stronger than the Eighth Prince. "Zhang Ruochen thought to himself.
"Hey! Isn't that the Ninth Prince? He actually came to Lin Mansion? "A young disciple of the Lin family showed a somewhat cold smile when he saw Zhang Ruochen standing outside the martial arts arena.
"He must be looking for Sister Ningshan again, but it's a pity that Sister Ningshan doesn't even bother to see him now. "
“I heard that he also activated the Mark of Divine Martial Arts. "
"Hee! I only opened the Divine Martial Mark at the age of sixteen, what can I do? If he wasn't Sister Cingshan's cousin, he might not even be able to enter the Lin family's door. "
"I heard that sister Ningshan is going to be engaged to the seventh prince. She is such a talented and beautiful girl! "
"hey-hey! It is said that the Ninth Prince has always been secretly in love with Sister Ningshan. Guess what his expression would be if he heard that Ningshan and His Highness the Seventh Prince were about to get engaged? "
All the young martial artists from the Lin family stopped practicing and stared at Zhang Ruochen who was standing outside the martial arts arena. They pointed, talked, and occasionally laughed jokingly.
Lin Cianshan also stopped practicing her sword and glanced at Zhang Ruochen who was standing outside the martial arts arena. With a slight wave of her slender jade arm, the star sword in her hand was accurately inserted into the scabbard.
Lin Nishan walked up to Zhang Ruochen, looked at Zhang Ruochen's thin body, and said, "Cousin, long time no see. I heard that you also activated the Mark of Divine Martial Arts? "
When they were very young, Lin Ningshan and Zhang Ruochen were good playmates and could be considered childhood sweethearts. However, later Lin Ningshan turned on the mark of Shenwu and spent most of their time together.He spent his time practicing and became more and more alienated from Zhang Ruochen.
After what happened three years ago, she never went to Yunwu Palace again. Although Zhang Ruochen has been sick all year round, he still often goes to the Lin family to see her. Even if he can see her once, he will feel quite happy.
However, the number of times I can see her is getting less and less, and I have never seen her in the past six months. She always sent a maid out to send Zhang Ruochen away.
"It turns out she's my cousin."
It can be said that this is the first time Zhang Ruochen has met Lin Nianshan now, and he has no feelings for her, so he obviously
Very calmly, he said humbly: "It is true that the divine martial mark has been activated, but the queen said that it is just a divine martial seal without a grade. Naturally, it cannot be compared with the divine martial seal of my cousin."
Lin Ningshan nodded, raising her snow-white chin, as proud as a white swan, and said: "You are already sixteen years old after all. Being able to activate the mark of divine martial arts is a gift from God. You must practice hard in the future. Although you cannot become a strong martial artist, you can at least strengthen your body and don't have to lie in a hospital bed all year round. For you... you can at least be a normal person."
Zhang Ruochen frowned slightly, nodded and said, "I will definitely practice hard in the future and try to catch up with your cousin."
Lin Nishan naturally knew that Zhang Ruochen liked her. When she heard Zhang Ruochen's words, she thought that Zhang Ruochen still refused to give up and wanted to continue pursuing her.
"Hey! Cousin, my cultivation level has reached the middle extreme level of the Huangji Realm, and I am only one step away from the Great Extreme Realm. With your qualifications, it is estimated that you will never reach the Middle Extreme Realm in your lifetime. The most important thing for you to do now is to practice down-to-earth, and don't blindly pursue things that you shouldn't pursue. You can't be too ambitious, otherwise you will suffer the consequences." Lin Nishan said with a double entendre.
Zhang Ruochen's brows furrowed deeper.
Lin Cianshan glanced at Zhang Ruochen with some sympathy and said, "Cousin, there is one more thing I want to tell you. I hope you won't be too sad. In three months, when the prince comes out of seclusion, His Highness the Seventh Prince and I will be engaged."
"There's a good show to watch! Hehe!"
The young warriors of the Lin family were all very happy, and they all stared at Zhang Ruochen, wanting to see what kind of reaction Zhang Ruochen would have?
